duplicate_review.note: Overlapping claims were retained when they originated from distinct source locations or exposed source inconsistencies.

consistency_findings.detail: Abstract reports n=9 (30%); Results/Table 3 report n=11 (36.7%).
Results/Table 3 report grade 3 myelosuppression in 4 patients; Discussion reports 3.
Table 1 reports 5 patients with previous WBRT; narrative reports 8.
Narrative reports BM vs no-BM median OS 8 vs 11 months, p=0.2058; Figure 3C reports 8 vs 13 months, p=0.2080.
Methods define primary endpoint as clinical response rate; Figure 1 labels it objective response rate (ORR).
Table displays Mean 9–70 and Range 28 for time from NSCLC diagnosis to meningeal metastasis; extraction preserves this without correction.

extraction_limitations: No reference-list entries were atomized; references were treated as provenance/task-queue infrastructure.

The study’s primary efficacy response definition is nonstandard and depends on neurologic symptoms/signs plus KPS; Supplemental Table 1 was included because it is load-bearing for endpoint interpretation.

Figure 2 contains patient-level treatment histories that were visually reconciled for SEA but were not converted into individual patient-level atoms because the figure does not provide sufficiently reliable machine-readable labels for every segment.
Source-internal numerical inconsistencies were preserved and flagged rather than silently reconciled.
